_comment: The script fetches the live dataset first and only falls back to this
file when it cannot reach Sanity. Run it with network access and this
Every field GATE M compares — guid, publishedAt, fileSize, duration,
title, audioUrl — is verbatim from the dataset. The summary values are
NOT verbatim: they are shortened stand-ins, because the capture tool
could not return the full text. Nothing in the comparison reads them.
Escaping of free text is proven separately by the hostile-input case in
the script rather than by whatever these happen to contain.

episodes.title: Away For A While
episodes.summary: Stepping back from the noise, and how distance brings renewal.

episodes.title: Master What You Do
episodes.summary: A call to excellence: sharpen your skill so you can serve well.

episodes.title: I Wish I Were
episodes.summary: Use what God gave you, however small it seems, to serve others.

episodes.title: Mekae (I Remember)
episodes.summary: The grind young people endure before a breakthrough, and its purpose.

episodes.title: Jesus' Call
episodes.summary: Christ's invitation to a transformed life of purpose and grace.

episodes.title: Education
episodes.summary: Learning, formal and informal, as the foundation for growth.

episodes.title: Ebi Jesus Wey Dey Rule
episodes.summary: Jesus' authority over all things, King above every circumstance.

episodes.title: My Real Gee
episodes.summary: Jesus as a close friend and constant companion in every season.
